meta.title: {brand} · Lost & found licence plates in Thailand
meta.description: Lost a licence plate in a flood, or found one? Post it here. We match plate numbers and alert the owner straight away. Free, no ads.

language.switchToLabel: เปลี่ยนเป็นภาษาไทย

home.title: Lost a plate in the flood? Let's get it home.
home.lead: People who lost a plate register the number. People who found one send a photo. We match them and tell the owner right away.
home.actionsLabel: What would you like to do?

lost.title: I lost a plate
lost.hint: Register your plate. We'll alert you the moment someone finds it.

found.title: I found a plate
found.hint: Take a photo of it and we'll help find the owner.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Register a lost plate, or photograph one you found
how.step3: You contact each other to arrange the handover

dormant.title: We're closed for now
dormant.body: We'll reopen when floods return. Stay safe.

footer.nonCommercial: Non-profit. No ads. We never ask for money.
footer.privacy: No GPS tracking. Posts are deleted automatically when they expire.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the post has been removed.
